## TemplateEngine.\_processGCallbackAnswerBlocks() method

Block: g-callback-answer Extracts `<g-callback-answer>` plain-text blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGCallbackAnswerBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: string;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: string; }

An object mapping language keys to their raw text content

## Remarks

Children form only (`<g-callback-answer>text</g-callback-answer>`<!-- -->); content is cleaned exactly like `<g-message>` (leading indent stripped, surrounding newlines trimmed) and keyed by `lang` (`"default"` when absent; last block wins per lang). Raw content is preserved verbatim (including `{{var|filter}}` spans) for later compilation. Plain-text and length rules are enforced by `validateBlockGCallbackAnswerAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const blocks = TemplateEngine._processGCallbackAnswerBlocks(`<g-callback-answer>Pesanan {{orderId}} diproses</g-callback-answer>`);
// Result: { default: 'Pesanan {{orderId}} diproses' }
```
